title: Making Electro-Competent E. coli Cells and Transformation
author: Jasper Koehorst
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vzfe73n

steps.title: Prepare Overnight Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL of LB without salt in a 50 mL culturing tube with E. coli and incubate overnight at 37°C and 250 rpm.

steps.title: Expand Culture to Target Density
steps.instruction: Inoculate 400 mL of LB without salt in a 1 L Erlenmeyer flask with enough of the overnight culture to reach an OD600 of 0.2. Incubate for approximately 3 hours until the OD600 reaches 0.5-1.0.

steps.title: Cool Cells on Ice
steps.instruction: Transfer the culture volume into 8 Greiner tubes (50 mL each) and cool on ice for 15 minutes.

steps.title: First Wash Step
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells at 2000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C. Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 5 mL of 10% glycerol, add 45 mL of 10% glycerol, and shake by hand several times to mix.

steps.title: Second Wash Step
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells at 2000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C. Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 5 mL of 10% glycerol, add 45 mL of 10% glycerol, and shake by hand several times to mix.

steps.title: Third Wash and Pooling
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells at 2000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C. Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of ice-cold 10% glycerol. Pool the contents of all 8 tubes into a single tube.

steps.title: Final Concentration
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the pooled cells at 1500 g for 5 minutes at 4°C. Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 400 μL of 10% glycerol to achieve a final suspension volume of approximately 800 μL.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store
steps.instruction: Dispense 40 μL aliquots into pre-cooled Eppendorf tubes. Flash freeze the tubes using liquid nitrogen (N2(l)) and store at -80°C.
